# Prime Lessons

> > Prime Lessons provides comprehensive robotics programming education for LEGO SPIKE Prime and MINDSTORMS platforms with multilingual support.

Prime Lessons is a tutorial platform dedicated to teaching robotics programming and design using LEGO's SPIKE Prime and MINDSTORMS Robot Inventor kits. The site serves a global audience with content available in English, Hebrew, and Arabic, covering everything from beginner coding tutorials to FIRST LEGO League competition preparation.

## Key Topics

- SPIKE Prime
- MINDSTORMS Robot Inventor
- FIRST LEGO League (FLL)
- Robotics Programming
- LEGO Robotics
- Robot Design
- Coding Tutorials
- Robotics Education
- Arvind Seshan
- Sanjay Seshan
- Programming Lessons
- FLL Resources
- Educational Platform
- Hands-on Learning

## Getting Started

- [Home (English)](https://primelessons.org/en/): Prime Lessons homepage for SPIKE Prime and MINDSTORMS robotics education
- [Home (Hebrew)](https://primelessons.org/he/index.html): Prime Lessons homepage in Hebrew for robotics programming lessons
- [Home (Arabic)](https://primelessons.org/ar/index.html): Prime Lessons homepage in Arabic for LEGO robotics education
